products.name: Forcepoint Neo to Netskope Migration (Legacy Web Filtering) — Commercial
products.short_description: A controlled migration from Forcepoint Neo to Netskope — translate filtering policy, manage agent coexistence, steer traffic in stages, and decommission the legacy platform once Netskope is proven. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Migrate off legacy web filtering to Netskope — without a gap in protection

Replacing a legacy web-filtering platform like Forcepoint Neo is risky: leave both agents on and they fight over traffic; cut over too fast and you lose protection or break access. This solution gives you a controlled migration from Forcepoint Neo to Netskope — translate existing filtering policy, manage agent coexistence, steer traffic in stages, and decommission the legacy platform once Netskope is proven.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the migration model, mapping legacy web-filtering policy to Netskope, agent coexistence and steering conflicts, and the staged cutover and decommission.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant + SWG, the existing Forcepoint Neo configuration/policy export, Intune for agent management, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory and translate legacy policy, stand up Netskope policy, manage coexistence and remove the legacy agent in stages, validate parity, decommission Forcepoint, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — legacy-agent and policy discovery, post-migration parity validation, a migration coverage and conflict report, safe remediation (remove legacy agent), and a migration-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Web filtering moved off Forcepoint Neo to Netskope with no gap in protection — policy translated, agents coexisting then cut over in stages, and the legacy platform decommissioned — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NSMIG-Discovery.ps1 — detect the Forcepoint Neo agent and current web-steering state (read-only)
    • NSMIG-Remediation.ps1 — remove the legacy Forcepoint Neo agent (defaults to -WhatIf)
    • NSMIG-Report.ps1 — fleet migration coverage and conflict report (Microsoft Graph, read-only)
    • NSMIG-Set-MigrationRingTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the migration-ring and steering Entra
    • NSMIG-Validation.ps1 — confirm coexistence/cutover state on this device (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
